Who we are

Viber Sporting Company is an India focused golf brand development and distribution company. We partner selectively with brands across equipment, accessories and technology that are defined by innovation, craftsmanship, performance and purpose — building their presence in India through thoughtful positioning and carefully curated distribution.

02

How we work

Our focus goes beyond products. We create brand value, golfer engagement and enduring market presence across India's evolving golf landscape, combining local market access, specialist golf relationships, experience led selling and disciplined market development.

Why Viber

India is entering a new phase of golf growth.

Viber Sporting Company is positioned to help international golf brands enter and develop the Indian market through a focused, experience led approach.

Market Development
Building awareness before scaling distribution.
Specialist Golf Network
Connecting brands with golf retailers, pro shops, courses, coaches and players.
Experience led Selling
Fittings, demo days, events and product experiences that create genuine golfer engagement.
Long term Brand Building
Developing sustainable brand presence rather than pursuing short-term volume.
Beyond distribution

We don't just distribute the brand. We build it.

Through carefully curated experiences, partnerships and market touchpoints, we build meaningful connections between exceptional golf brands and India's evolving golf audience. Distribution is only one part of building a successful brand — awareness, product experience, retail relationships, professional engagement and market development all matter.
